svg.title: Polynomials with roots 1 and 2 in two kinds of network
svg.desc: Left: with five reactions, the polynomials (x+a)(x-1)(x-2) join a sign pattern to a different one along one straight line of rate constants. Right: with three two-way sources, only (x-1)(x-2) and its negative are available, and they meet only at the identically zero polynomial.
svg.text: (x + a)(x − 1)(x − 2), coefficient signs change with a
only ±(x − 1)(x − 2), which meet only at f ≡ 0
Dots: the two steady states, x = 1 and x = 2, shared by every curve.
